pages.title: Mundane Hexbrew
pages.text: The plain foundation of witch brewing. Mundane Hexbrew is a water-based stock with no special drinking or throwing effect. Bottles hold 250 mB, and other hexbrews are made from this base.

pages.title: Explosive Hexbrew
pages.text: Throw this bottle to create a power-4 explosion. It damages enemies without breaking blocks, and the blast does not harm you or your allies.

pages.title: Miasma Hexbrew
pages.text: A throwable brew that inflicts Miasma for 60 seconds. Afflicted targets take 50% more damage, have their armor effectiveness halved and heal 30% less. They may also gain negative effects when hurt.

pages.title: Hexbrew Elixir
pages.text: This concentrated brew is neither drinkable nor throwable. It is valuable for dealings with Marisa: you can earn one through her brewing quest, or trade 4 Mundane Hexbrew bottles for one once you reach 80 reputation with her.

pages.title: Shield Hexbrew
pages.text: Drink this brew to gain Starlight Shield for 60 seconds, giving you extra absorption. It is not made in the Alchemy Pot; Marisa will trade it to you at 50 reputation.

pages.title: Starlight Hexbrew
pages.text: Throw this starry brew to deal 4 magic damage and inflict Sparkling for 60 seconds. Whenever a Sparkling target is hit, a ring of 16 star bullets erupts and fights for you. Marisa offers it once you reach 120 reputation.

pages.title: Hyphae Hexbrew
pages.text: A throwable infection brew that inflicts Hyphae Infection for 60 seconds, dealing 1 magic damage each second. It also briefly grows hyphae and converts nearby dirt into mycelium within 4 blocks. This brew is not currently obtainable in Survival.
